query: query NbaElig($s1: String!, $t1: ID!, $s2: String!, $cards: [String!]!) { anyCards(slugs: $cards) { slug usedIn(taskId: $t1) { __typename } s1: eligiblePlayerGameScores(stepId: $s1) { scoringVersion projectedScore projection { score reliabilityBasisPoints grade } anyGame { id date ... on GameOfBasketball { statusTyped homeTeam { slug } awayTeam { slug } } } } s2: eligiblePlayerGameScores(stepId: $s2) { anyGame { id date } } ... on NBACard { basketballPlayer { slug rawPlayerGameScores(last: 15) averageScore(type: LAST_TEN_PLAYED_SO5_AVERAGE_SCORE) } } } }
